title: Software Development Engineer I
description: Amazon IN Payments is building PayUI, a new suite of standardized, reusable UX components for Amazon Pay pages. The team is building a large-scale tier-1 rendering platform that payment pages will depend on to host and render experiences used by thousands of customers daily. Engineers work across requirements review, service and interface design, UX component development, prototyping, coding, testing, and delivery. The role collaborates with product managers, UX designers, software developers, and client teams to build customer experiences across Amazon Pay use cases.
